spec: ENCRYPTION.md 5.3: header(magic,version,suite,chunk_size,nonce_base8), chunk nonce = nonce_base || u32be(index), aad = header || u64be(file_id) || u32be(index). Chunk size64 keeps every vector small; the reader takes the value from the header. Encryption uses a fresh nonce base, so vectors pin the read side - the JS write side is pinned by crypto-roundtrip.js.
